funder.quote: have total eligible project costs between £100,000 and £500,000
funder.says: the £ window bounds TOTAL ELIGIBLE PROJECT COSTS, and the branch is selected by PROJECT DURATION. Neither quantity is an intake field: we ask ticketBand, which types.ts defines as 'how much they are looking for', i.e. the grant sought. The funder's own intensity caps on the same page put the grant at 25%-70% of project cost (G3-03, G3-04), so a project cost cannot be read off a grant band. The comparator therefore tests a number the founder never gave against a rule they may not even be under.
